Cause: `refund_amount` charged tax on the pre-discount line net, not the post-discount taxable amount. For the ticket, the first 2 chairs refunded 68.85 + 7.25% of 76.50 = 74.40 instead of 68.85 + 7.25% of 68.85 = 73.84.
